verdict.rationale: CSC documents a centralized, secure dashboard of entity information across all jurisdictions, and CSCNavigator links filed evidence to entities with 24x7 access. It also keeps a real-time Compliance Calendar and delivers searchable SOP documents, covering entities, state registrations and received documents in one place. Team access is only implied, through email reminders to unlimited users and SOP routing to designated contacts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-user team accounts with roles/permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the unified CSCNavigator experience.
